description: Declared mutants of render targets, texture formats and the one clip-from-world value (render-pipeline declaration section 13, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a1; T1 to T7 and the reviews' S-1 to S-3, H1, H3; camera CM-5, CM-7; render RD-3, RD-11). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The gt- mutants need a GPU (label gpu). Queue2d and Queue3d taking the one value are guarded by p2-view-ignored and p3-view-ignored (render_mutations.json), a released target staying live by rd-tex-release-kept-live (the same Release since targets and textures share one table), not repeated here. Not added (with the reason): UpdateCameraViews' explicit order after UpdateCameras and after TransformPropagate (the kernel already runs an undeclared conflicting pair in registration order, and camera's row depends on transform: a mutant that drops either order survives every case, run 2026-11-27; stated as visibility's is); a target made being transparent black (a new texture is zero on the drivers tried, so no case can tell it from one not cleared); a target's own depth texture (with every target the main target's size in the tests a shared depth draws the same; RC-A1-3); SDL's refusal counted once per size and the backend's format support check (no driver in CI refuses Rgba8Unorm or Rgba8UnormSrgb); render targets drawn in a frame the window gives no picture (no test minimizes a window); the Programmer Errors of a zero target size, an sRGB target, following a target that is not live and an update of a target (asserts, guarded by their GYO_CHECK_ASSERTS cases).
